question:
Kustomize files for the route board are in `/home/candidate/exam/q12`: a `base/` and an example overlay `overlays/staging/`, which is already applied in namespace `routes`. Create the overlay `overlays/prod/` and apply it with `kubectl apply -k`:

- It builds on `../../base`, puts everything in namespace `routes` and prefixes all names with `prod-`.
- Label every resource `env=prod`. The prod Deployment and Service must select only prod Pods; the namespace also runs other Pods labelled `app=route-board`.
- The Deployment runs 3 replicas and its `web` container uses `nginx:1.26` (the other container is unchanged).
- The generated ConfigMap keeps all base keys, except that `ROUTE_MODE` becomes `express`, and it gains `NIGHT_SERVICE=enabled`. Extend the base generator (merge) instead of redefining it.
- Do not modify `base/` or `overlays/staging/`.

Verify with: `kubectl -n routes get endpoints prod-route-board`

verification.description: overlays/prod renders, builds on ../../base, and base/ and overlays/staging/ are unchanged
Deployment prod-route-board: selector app=route-board,env=prod, 3 Ready replicas, web nginx:1.26, feed-sync busybox:1.36
The Deployment uses the rendered prod-route-settings-<hash> ConfigMap with the merged data (behavior: merge)
Service prod-route-board selects app=route-board,env=prod and its endpoints are exactly the 3 prod Pods
